title: Tech Note: Partial Data File Verification
author: Jesse Pina, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: VERIFY CURRENT DATA FILE (introduced 4D v11 SQL)

historical_commentary.text: This note documents VERIFY CURRENT DATA FILE / VERIFY DATA FILE, commands introduced in 4D v11 SQL for programmatic data/index file verification including partial (targeted object/table/field) checks and a callback mechanism for custom handling of results. These are foundational database-maintenance commands that remain part of current 4D versions and continue to function essentially as documented, making the technique still directly applicable today; database integrity verification is a timeless operational need unaffected by later architectural shifts like ORDA or Project mode, though modern 4D deployments may also lean on newer built-in maintenance/monitoring tooling introduced in subsequent versions alongside these commands.
